title: AI Executive
job_description:
1–5 years of experience in AI implementation, automation, digital transformation, operations improvement, or related fields Familiar with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Notion AI, or similar platforms Basic knowledge of prompt engineering and no-code automation tools Familiar with Google Workspace, Excel, or Google Sheets Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Fast learner with interest in new technology and AI trends Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical teams Hands-on, proactive, and execution-focused mindset Ability to simplify complex processes into practical solutions Bonus Skills (Added Advantage) Experience with Zapier, Make AI (Integromat) , Python, or API integrations Familiar with Shopify, Shopee, TikTok Shop, or e-commerce systems Experience using AI video, design, or content generation tools Knowledge in process optimization or productivity tracking

Study current company workflows and identify areas that can be improved with AI or automation Research, test, and implement suitable AI tools for different departments Create AI-assisted workflows for customer service, marketing, HR, operations, and e-commerce Develop prompt libraries, templates, and simple SOPs for internal team usage Train staff on how to use AI tools effectively in their daily work Monitor latest AI trends, tools, and industry best practices Track productivity improvements, operational efficiency, and time-saving results after implementation Assist in automating reporting, content creation, meeting summaries, and internal processes Work together with teams to ensure AI solutions are practical and easy to use
